patterns.prevention:
• Assign a primary and backup coach to each centre before the start date, with written confirmation of availability for the full program duration.

• Conduct weekly check-ins with coaches during their first month to identify scheduling conflicts or coverage issues before sessions are missed.

• Establish a minimum 2-week notice requirement for coach changes or withdrawals, with mandatory replacement coach identified before the original coach's final session.

• Create a centre onboarding checklist that includes coach introductions, contact details, and contingency contacts shared with centre management at least 5 days before the first session.
